catalog.summary: Burned-in captions: each cue appears for its frames, broken into lines by the delivery profile's caption rules.
catalog.use_when: A deliverable's profile requires burned-in captions. The shot compiler (M3.4) writes the cues from line timestamps; agents rarely place this by hand.
catalog.avoid_when: Titles or on-screen text that is part of the design (use kinetic_title).
